details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (def at line ~3041) and _resolve_origin_url (lines ~3074-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: HTTPS clone URLs embed GH_TOKEN as `https://x-access-token:<token>@...` instead of using credential-free URLs with per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: Tokens appear in argv, `.git/config`, Git diagnostics, process listings, and remote output, breaking the repository's credential-isolation contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 578-588 (_memory_force_tick_remote_url printf with https://x-access-token:${token}@); lines 594-604 / 767-773 / 883-889 / 919-925 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed, force-tick operations use token-embedded remote URLs, and memory Git operations use bare Git commands without scoped authentication.
  WHY: Tokens leak through process state and Git output, while `persist-credentials: false` leaves memory clone, branch, and push operations unauthenticated and silently fail-open.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 665-670 (the `codex ... --sandbox danger-full-access` invocation); the broker startup block at lines 212-222 was removed | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase directly runs issue-derived Codex input with `--sandbox danger-full-access` while `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` are available, bypassing the model-provider broker.
  WHY: The model can read or exfiltrate workflow credentials and mutate the workspace outside the broker's PID namespace, ACL, and loopback-token boundary.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 152-157 (deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, `is_sensitive_target_path`) and lines 240-247 (normalize_path removes the sensitivity check) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed, allowing caller-supplied paths such as `.env`, `.git/config`, `.ssh/`, `.aws/`, and credential files to be resolved and read.
  WHY: Issue-, plan-, or PR-derived paths can expose credential-bearing files, including through repository-local symlinks, directly in model prompts.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 145-525 (model_provider_broker_start, model_provider_broker_stop, model_provider_broker_prepare_codex_writer, model_provider_broker_prepare_codex_readonly, model_provider_broker_exec_sanitized, model_provider_broker_exec_unprivileged, model_provider_broker_grant_read_path all deleted) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The broker lifecycle and execution helpers were deleted while production workflows and scripts still invoke them.
  WHY: Model phases fail with `command not found` before Codex starts, and the project-wide credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 29-31, 85-90, 143-148, 258-264 (--provider-base-url removed, base_url hard-coded) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed while callers still pass it, and `base_url` is hard-coded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Callers exit with an unknown-option error before writing configuration; direct successful writes bypass the loopback broker and expose the real provider key.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 7, 26-60 (--process-group-file removed from usage and argument parser) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `--process-group-file` option was removed while `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:553` still passes it.
  WHY: The stall guard exits with an unknown-option error before launching the editor, matching the repeated review/autofix no-output failures.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 947-1306 (review_blocked_decision_digest, review_blocked_find_pending_request, review_blocked_build_approval_request, review_blocked_approval_status, review_blocked_post_approval_request, review_blocked_post_consumed_marker, review_blocked_find_issue_for_request, review_blocked_build_successor_intent, review_blocked_successor_marker, review_blocked_ensure_successor_intent, review_blocked_resolve_successor_issue, review_blocked_prepare_successor_issue all deleted) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked approval, successor-issue, consumed-marker, and role-binding helper family was deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` still invoke it.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal decisions, approval requests, consumed markers, and successor handling fail with `command not found`, leaving blocked PRs stuck.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 493-498 (git_with_github_auth deleted) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` was deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` still calls it for judge-fix and baseline pushes.
  WHY: Those authenticated pushes fail with `command not found`, so review-blocked fix commits and baseline preservation cannot reach the remote branch.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 732-739 and 833-939 (REST and GraphQL comment transforms dropping id, author_id, author_type, author_association) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: REST and GraphQL `gh_pr_with_all_comments` transforms now omit `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Producer-comment binding and approver authorization cannot verify identity or trust role even if the review-blocked helpers are restored.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 29-38 (import MAX_TARGET_PATHS and import is_sensitive_target_path) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were deleted from `scripts.targeted_file_context.py`.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError`, so targeted-context contract tests cannot run.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 98-237 (staged-support restore block gated on STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER and STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but no workflow exports or creates them.
  WHY: The restore is dead code, so `SCRIPT_REF` helper copies can still overwrite branch-owned runtime helpers, reproducing the regression the block claims to prevent.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 202-205 — `git merge-file -p -L "editor" -L "staged ${SCRIPT_REF:-support ref}" -L "HEAD" -- "${staged_support_path}" "${staged_support_base}" "${staged_support_head}"` | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` arguments use the wrong base/other ordering for rebasing the editor's support-baseline edit onto HEAD.
  WHY: The three-way merge can lose branch edits or emit spurious conflicts; severity disagreement exists because moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly verified this call and reported it as not a defect.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 86-141 (Fetch memory helper scripts step no longer exports GH_TOKEN or scoped git config) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication configured in one workflow step is not exported to the helper-fetch step or later memory operations.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false` and bare Git calls, memory branch initialization and force-tick operations fail or silently degrade; severity disagreement exists because qwen_qwen3_7-plus and x-ai_grok-4_6 rated this major.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 536-716 (the rewritten `emit_context` body) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file, binary, and overflow markers do not consistently advance `used_bytes`, and `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` caps were removed.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can exceed `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES` and inflate model prompts beyond the intended bound.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 287-460 (the simplified kill / cleanup paths) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user process-group tracking, privileged signalling, descendant reaping, and survivor verification were removed.
  WHY: The sudo wrapper can exit while nobody-owned descendants remain alive, retaining workspace and FIFO handles; the guard checks only the wrapper and can report cleanup complete prematurely.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 137-180 (memory_ensure_branch); the earlier `_memory_git` callsites at lines 594-604 / 767-773 / 883-889 / 919-925 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Removing the per-subprocess authentication wrapper introduces a race and nondeterministic authentication boundary for concurrent memory writers.
  WHY: Inner shells may not inherit scoped Git configuration, causing concurrent memory branch and force-tick operations to fail-open or push without HTTP authentication.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 59-68 (pre_assembled_static.txt handling) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup changed from checking the HEAD tree and restoring both index and worktree to checking the index and restoring only the worktree.
  WHY: Staged or partially checked-out `pre_assembled_static.txt` content can remain in the index or be committed incorrectly, leaving stale tree entries and checkout conflicts.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 98-104 and 146-149 (patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config called and checked before capture validation) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Configuration patching runs before capture-file validation and continues after patch failure.
  WHY: It can write to an invalid or unintended `CODEX_HOME`, then proceed without broker isolation after only a warning.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
